notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – Update 23.06.2025
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Hex Warriors![/h1]

We’ve just released a new update for Neuroshima Hex on Steam.
This patch brings several important bug fixes and improvements to game stability and AI behavior. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/9748f8202fd5e5eb00737ac7e398959ceeb9dfae.png[/img]

🛠️See the full changelog below:
[list]

[*]"War of Attrition" Achievement Fixed

[*]Steel Police – Judge Unit - The Judge unit now properly reflects attacks as expected.

[*]We've improved how Steam mobile logins are handled. Cross-platform gameplay  between PC and mobile has been disabled to prevent related bugs.

[*]Vegas Castling Crash Resolved - Fixed a rare issue where the game would freeze if Vegas attempted a castling move with a taken-over token.

[*]Sharrash HQ Castling Bug Fixed - Resolved an infinite error loop involving the Sharrash HQ trying to move with modules in specific castling scenarios. Everything now works as intended.

[*]Mississippi’s paralysis now correctly affects the Sharrash Mortar unit.

[*]Improved AI

[*]Other Minor Fixes - Various small stability and performance improvements have been applied.
[/list]

[h2]⚠️ Important Note

Please update your game to the latest version (23.06.2025).
Playing on older versions may cause compatibility issues or bugs.[/h2]

[h2]🐞 Known Issues[/h2]

We’re aware of the following bugs and are working on fixes:

-The AI may sometimes try to place the HQ on an already occupied hex.

-Some unit descriptions are missing or incorrect in certain languages.

-Friend invites may get stuck in an infinite loop.

-Minor language and translation errors.


Stay tunned for more!
Thanks for your continued support!

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Neuroshima Hex - Devlog#12 New Army Overview is Here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Warriors of the Wastelands !![/h3]

Welcome to the Devlog #12! 

Hi! It’s been a while ;) 
We are working hard on all things from your's feedback from playtests.
And, here is one of many examples - improved army view (or overview) !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/0eb63b652ef4dacd398bf5afdbd2af9bc63a8b96.png[/img]
[i]Who is this "cypbaked" guy? ;)[/i]

We know that in the heat of battle, keeping track of your units, enemy forces, and discarded tokens can sometimes feel like trying to count bullets mid-fight. 
Well, worry no more! 
Our brand-new [b]Army Overview[/b] is here to save the day (and your tactical sanity).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/41c066896a672658dec4284f3beae55ea14d81fc.gif[/img]


With a single click, you now get an instant, clear view of:
✅ Your tokens (because knowing your own forces is kinda important).
✅ Your opponent’s tokens (because knowing their forces is even more important).
✅ Discarded tokens (for when you need to lament your losses or celebrate your opponent’s misfortunes).
✅ Tokens currently in hand (yours and your enemy’s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/731967a67412baad60d40c051a01af39400ae12e.gif[/img]
[i]It's tiles or tokens?[/i]

We made it so just one glance, and you’ll know everything you need to plan your next move like a true post-apocalyptic mastermind ;)
And of course one simple mouse right-click and the overview disappears. No need to move cursor on this X in the corner of the screen ;)

Ah, and you can click on token to see it in detailed view but that's in next devlog so stay tuned!


----


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

[url=https://discord.gg/DCwnjCX9AF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c104527459c290c25f34ca328e6a009dbc6c9554.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Neuroshima Hex - Devlog#11 - Multiplayer Rooms
notes.content:
[h3]Hello again Warriors of the Wastelands !![/h3]

Welcome to Devlog #11! 

Long time no see ;)
Today, we’re excited to unveil some key updates to Neuroshima Hex’s multiplayer system !!

Let’s dive in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/d607b57991a215a29b22f9678dd8a3953780f658.gif[/img]

[h1]Room System: Creating and Joining Games[/h1]

To personalize multiplayer experience, we’ve implemented the Create Room and Join Room features, giving players more control over how they can interact with their friends in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/749cb033a3eae7b493955212c469321e789847cd.gif[/img]

[h2]Creating a Room: [/h2]

As the game host, you can now set up a room with a unique Room Name and Password. This lets you ensure that only invited players can join the match, We will add an OBSERVER feature too so other players can watch your battlefields!

[h2]Joining a Room: [/h2]

Players looking to jump into a match can easily do so by entering the Room Name and Password. Once they have the correct information, they’re in ! 

Those features was implemented with a TOURNAMENT settings in the mind. 
Or you can let's say stream your game, share a room name and passwords and wait for a worthy opponent!


[h2]Kick Functionality ;) [/h2]

In cases where you need to manage players in your room, we’ve added a Kick function. This allows the host to remove any player from the game lobby. Useful if you lost a match ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/3d896d055e7700a40cd94fca86b97f2d6709d0c5.gif[/img]
[i]My STEEL friend got kicked ;)[/i]

Yes, you can see it well it's the TIMER mechanics that Players often requested.
It's still a work in progress but we hope to deliver this funcionality :D
[h3]What is better: 60 seconds for a move or a timer like in chess? Tell us in comments![/h3]

More about that in new devlog! Stay tuned!

----


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

[url=https://discord.gg/DCwnjCX9AF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c104527459c290c25f34ca328e6a009dbc6c9554.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Neuroshima Hex - New UI/UX Part 1
notes.content:
Hello!

Welcome, dear strategists and warriors of the wasteland!

In this devlog, I will show you some UI changes that we recently added to Neuroshima Hex for PC!

The UI (user interface) is an important thing, especially in video games. In board games, it's a bit tricky since there is no "pop-up window" on the table where you're playing the board game, eh?

But in digital games, the UI plays a great role!

We will allow you to take a sneak peek before the premiere, but remember that it's still a WIP (work in progress).

We took some of the feedback you gave us after the demo and on social media, and we definitely improved the UI and its experience in Neuroshima Hex for PC. (You will have a chance to check it out soon enough. ;) )

[h1]Token Check[/h1]

Let's start with the "Token/Tile Check" function. This simple mechanic allows you to check the properties of any token you select.

Here is the old version. The fonts are too big, and there is a scroller. Not good enough!
[h2]OLD[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/971f469d2387b60ae1d9d8f3c7659505613c8dd2.png[/img]

Now, for the new version!
[b][h2]NEW[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/170c05442c5b3098aef0650ce8b630214c114bc0.png[/img]
At just one glance, players can see all a unit's properties, including special features, stats, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/8e252f0e31d12a5acc86801e7db53c56c20bb9b2.png[/img]


[h1]Creating New Game[/h1]

We also changed the screens for creating a game and selecting your armies, AI level, etc.

Old ones - simple but not amusing:
[h2][b]OLD[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/844cbb67e0340fbd2bee7e0a98d6c04ad454817e.png[/img]

New ones!!
[h2][b]NEW[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/580bc8ca439b82c9194f3da0687442567f9038f2.gif[/img]

Now they are combined into one big screen with additional features. It's easier to navigate! Believe me.
Online multiplayer screens are similar. Just wait for the new devlog. ;)

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]

As a bonus, we present an additional feature you requested in our polls and messages: [b]shortcuts![/b]
Simple as that, but definitely useful (especially for experienced players). For example, you can use your mouse scroll to change the direction of tokens before placing them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/38891aef90edc921bfd8827245a8dc07505ea2fe.gif[/img]
You can minimize the box with shortcut tooltips if you memorized them all. ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/644dcd2011022b16001ca67f4d7e749631429671.gif[/img]
That's all for today, but be ready for a new UI/UX devlog really soon. ;)

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Neuroshima Hex - Armies: Uranopolis summary
notes.content:
Hello!

Welcome, dear strategists and warriors of the wasteland!

Greetings, fellow strategists and warriors of the Neuroshima Hex universe! Today, we delve into the intricate world of Uranopolis, a formidable army that brings both innovation and destruction to the hexagonal battlefield. In this devlog, we'll unravel the secrets of Uranopolis and highlight its four best units, each contributing uniquely to the tactical prowess of this powerful faction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/ab349a59010819f0a9afe7e59042af8e220a74a7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Uranopolis - Electric Surge of Destruction![/h1]

Can you imagine a world without electricity? Uranopolis army cannot!
Those bad boys use electro power to power up their advanced machinery! 
I wonder who pays the electric bill....
That's ever changing post-apocalyptic warfare in Neuroshima Hex!

You can read in official army description:

[b]Uranopolis [/b]- [i]"Pre-war uranium mines with a hidden underground equipment and crews managed to survive the apocalypse and are still extracting valuable uranium. Over the following decades, many of the heavy mining machinery were transformed into deadly weapons and sent to defend the underground fortresses. This way a new town was founded. Uranopolis - a rich mining town, effectively guarding their treasures from being plundered by grabby neighbors."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/59f5fd4f86149cb954807dde2852f201292adacd.png[/img]

Energy as a strategic resource - For Uranopolis, electricity is not just a necessity; it's a strategic resource that influences every decision on the battlefield. Some units - notably the HQ are the "power sources" and most of the units are labeled as "requiring power supply". In other words - they cannot function (even attack or defend themselves!) without the support of electricity providers!

But don't worry, just place those mechanical monstrosities  near an electric supply and they are going to wreck havoc on battlefield! (until electric bill arrives)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/1903927496c2fc555936f25b52e1d7d4a3f8e267.gif[/img]
Units that require electric power are labeled in this blue outline. If power is OFF they don't stop blinking ;(

[h1]Strategies and Noteworthy Units[/h1]

Rule no 1 - REMEMEBER ABOUT POWER SUPPLY
same applies when you play AGAINST Uranopolis - without the power source  they cannot do much damage.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/8964dd6d887328bda660dc902f2201559902dd14.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/8187348f9479304113079740a44672d090142134.png[/img][/url]
[b]Mechanic[/b] - this lovely lady is one of the few units that can provide power to other units. She also has the ablility to MOVE so she will be running around battlefield to get to the power hungry machines.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/bfdd65b3da442dcde8dbdcde872fec23572a5032.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/14edb413ee20710691cf644aba70caea0dbde109.png[/img][/url]
[b]Ray[/b] - Ray (of energy) is powerful tool in the assets of Uranopolis army. Just use this  Instant Action token on the battlefield to damage all units in a straight line ! There is only 1 in the entire deck so use it wisely.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/e6b9bba560d386cfd95fb906ea9a70427712b03b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/b6e58f72b5010437c49c047c1cacac193f4e7d0e.png[/img][/url]
[b]Ravager[/b] - this bad boy can attack uses a special DEMOLITION attack. It has bigger range that standard attack but can't be buffed by modules and abilities. Also, he requires power so remember to get a mechanic near him!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/3235d35b2bb83da469f9346c8becffbb9217bea3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/fe98e79a1c574dbacaaa5fbb311d1b63a3dd3bd3.png[/img][/url]
[b]Gauss Transformer[/b]- Ladies and gentlemen - we get to the very powerful module - A Gauss Transformer can change the range attack of its connected unit to a Gauss Attack!!! Gauss Attack- can get through multiple tokens on board!!! Very powerful! Can carry games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/d9125f5012fa084342d20c9e05b5fbb71f8042b6.gif[/img]

In the unforgiving world of [i]Neuroshima Hex,[/i] where survival hinges on adaptability and strategic acumen, [i]Uranopolis [/i]stands as a testament to the transformative power of electricity. The faction's insatiable need for energy not only defines its character but also shapes the dynamics of every battle in which it engages. It's a hard to play faction but very original. 

Wanna feel the power??

------


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

[url=https://discord.gg/DCwnjCX9AF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c104527459c290c25f34ca328e6a009dbc6c9554.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Neuroshima Hex - Armies: Sharrash summary
notes.content:
Hello!

Welcome, dear strategists and warriors of the wasteland!

Step right up, Neuroshima enthusiasts! Get ready for a journey into the heart of chaos as we unveil the latest addition to Neuroshima Hex - introducing the [b]Sharrash [/b]army! For those familiar with the board game, get ready to witness the mayhem of the [b]Sharrash [/b]on your PC screen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/314eafb788eead34009377942560da690e055dce.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sharrash: Underground Dance of Destruction[/h1]

Post-apocalyptic warfare and mutant rats - it must gone wrong!
Don't give any cheese to those pets!
The Sharrash army has arrived.

You can read in official army description:

[i]"[b]Sharrash [/b]is a mysterious and well-organized community of mutant rats endowed with inhuman intelligence. They live underground, in tunnels and canals of the destroyed cities, along with degenerate humans and mutants who serve the [b]Sharrash[/b]. They do not allow strangers anywhere near them, fiercely defend their nests, and their fighters will not hesitate to give their life for the pack."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/02412d2210d003b8c676c5a995ce23b741a0da7d.png[/img]

The Sharrash army boasts a set of distinct advantages that set it apart on the battlefield. Notably, the mobility of their HQ stands out, allowing for strategic positioning and adaptability in the face of evolving threats.

However, like any force, the Sharrash army carries its share of vulnerabilities.
Notably, the absence of armors in their repertoire calls for a strategic approach, emphasizing precision over resilience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/4b7dce3c1e631e7aef5a1984cbb2c58818da479b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Strategies and Noteworthy Units[/h1]

A standout feature in the Sharrash arsenal is the special Foundation Tile (like Mine in other armies)  known as [b]the Hole[/b]. 
This formidable piece is not easily discarded and serves as a formidable obstacle, disrupting enemy plans and establishing a strong defensive foothold.
You probably thinking: "what? its just a hole in ground! How can it be dangeroues??"

Yes , but what if this hole leads to UNDERGROUND where wild mutans and abnormalities awaits for their dinner?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/0002a4e1ac01c9c82605d713eb3bc914871b2d2d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/2cfcbf83ae3d33d40afeef8329560d63aeb40438.png[/img][/url]

[b]The HOLE[/b] - you can drag any nearby unit to the hole - after a next battle an unit will automacialy die! And the Hole awaits its next prey !


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/32c646085925ac6d6d2a2e1f26b2e3179c3a6fd9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/5de54699cfef30d064afdeea0e229b5e8f9eb0d5.png[/img][/url]

[b]Paralysis[/b] - Leveraging paralysis strategically in the Neuroshima Hex game can be a game-changer, turning the tide of battle in your favor. The ability to immobilize attacks of enemy units offers a myriad of tactical advantages that savvy commanders can exploit! Paralysis is available also in other armies but the Sharrash have this as "instant action" (use whethever you want)

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/7e1a80e95a4d62d5950d87138c54c72cc5199ffc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/ca0e9dff7deceecb01366581b26c4bda1232572f.png[/img][/url]
[b]Beast[/b] - where is the beauty? This small, rat pet can destroy targets in melee combat. It has whooping 3 attacks !!!! Useful in attacking a HQ.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/7ff5d4c77c593e0443fb4a25af8155963b714d8d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/5911c0ae667a500712027e19e8b158a5073279d9.png[/img][/url] 

[b]Underground [/b]- as previously mentioned - units with Underground ability can change its place with a Sharrash HQ. Every turn! For free! Use it to your advantage!  Also this module can give Underground ability to every unit on board! Just palce it and don't get it destroyed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/9f26c959b42b66022e730e767fb50f186d9b9e55.gif[/img]

That's all for today. We had fun implementing those armies and we are hoping that you will have fun playing Neuroshima Hex on PC :D

notes.title: Neuroshima Hex - Armies: Neojungle summary
notes.content:
Hello!

Welcome, dear strategists and warriors of the wasteland!

Hey there, Hex-heads! Time for another wild ride through the post-apocalyptic madness, and this time, we've got a surprise waiting for you in the overgrown corners of Neuroshima Hex - introducing the Neojungle army!
Of course you can know Neojungle from a board game but in this devlog we wanna show you how we implemented this army to the PC version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/ee5f245a5cbc8af7283f6dab56af837d4ecd9f5d.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Neojungle: Rules of Nature?[/h1]

Ever wondered what would happen if Mother Nature took a crash course in coding? 
Well, wonder no more! The Neojungle army is here!

You can read in official army description:

[i]When survivors of humanity started to get up from their knees after the destructive war, when they were looking in fear to the North at the terrain occupied by robots, in the South a new threatening force was born, a force as strong as Moloch but not as dynamic. Slowly but surely an overwhelming mutated jungle started to grow. It was driven by an ungoverned survival instinct, and with each passing year it devours new kilometers of human earth. It assimilates everything it comes into contact with, changing animals and people into mutated beasts and symbiotic organisms, which enable it to go forward and destroy the next threat. This huge green and ferocious organism was called [b]Neojungle[/b].[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/2a0625adcc0b05becbb927b4bdf1d5835905c25b.png[/img]

From the ferocious Nightshades to the tought Mosters, the Neojungle army is a force to be reckoned with!
Their units and their special ability "Motherland", offering a unique and versatile set of skills that will challenge even the most seasoned Hex commanders!

[h1]Strategies and interesting units[/h1]

Need a help? see this graph and just stick to it to absolutely win every match!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/217a7b4cda23bb313da4b486eb16ad9d92a4b314.png[/img]

Just kidding :D
Here we will talk about some interesting units and strategies how to use Neojungle propely :D
We will start with the most important one: [b]MOTHERLAND[/b]

What is this ability???
MOTHERLAND -  All owned units that are adjacent to a unit with Motherland ability belong to the Motherland. Modules that belong to the player which are linked to any unit in the Motherland  give their bonuses to each unit in the Motherland.

I hope it is enlightening :D So basically all your connected units on board are STRONGER together! (even stronger than FAMILY??)

Units in Motherland are represented by green outline. Also the first unit to start a Motherland is ofc a Neojungle HQ ! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/e2af958e2458265a2ce883d51f854d6acee317ca.png[/img]

[b]Nightshade [/b]- you can see this guy in the cover for Neojungle! Is that mean that he is so strong? Kind of. He is regular unit but with VENOM ability. Use him for strong adversaries!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/880abd466f303ac365f63c4ef2d3b0e76557db02.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/0b9fc567f65665c44d1459359c13f363b313a327.png[/img][/url]

[b]Monster [/b]- this monstrority attack on almost every corner! (like HQ) . Is a bit slow (0 initiative) but even have strong 3 and 2 attack on top! Definetly gonna use it!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/fb4e06c06e74f34ba189eb6168f2d1ed0492a23b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/5b5b52ab8412dd58187bd4cc4ad277db52e00a97.png[/img][/url]

[b]Symbionts [/b]- modules that upgrade other units. Remember about Motherland!!! Making use of modules is the thing that every Neojungle player should do!! It will drive you to victory !

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/ca977a3dafbcc74d4e053da5526a0762441972e8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/e3c1d3da78378c23292b3c23cc375ed6e9b430b7.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/1b7d867053b043d568c4e50906681c696430fac7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/2d870dca934f67f18c8a6fb338c9d405d4071ddd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/472ad7553fc7d88086da7c60cb26cca4e3458e7d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/a0a7bc024d92dfbdf91f227e76cb24c451b82398.png[/img][/url]

[b]Slicer [/b]- average unit but you can get 4 of them in your deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/3c3ffda25d39b12aad84188a1316077e2f319bcc.jpg[/img]

[b]Small Bomb [/b]- oooouuu yeah tha'ts what im talking. Rememebr the unfamous AIR STRIKE from Moloch army? Well in Neojungle you can get a AIR STRIKE but a version "small fries" (still deadly). 
Small bomb attacks 3 desired hexes (must be near other) and absolutely destroys almost everything!
Strong token but only one in deck. Use it wisely!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366745/de3c08b0b95a25ba2996883cf79279bc85b861d0.gif[/img]

That's all for today. We had fun implementing those armies and we are hoping that you will have fun playing Neuroshima Hex on PC :D

------


Best regards,
Baked Games Team
